title: RFM Customer Analytics Dashboard
description: Interactive RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis dashboard that segments customers based on purchasing behavior. Visualizes customer value tiers, identifies high-value segments, and surfaces actionable retention strategies.
impact: Identified top-value customer segments enabling targeted campaigns with measurable revenue impact.

title: Customer Retention Dashboard
description: End-to-end customer retention analytics platform tracking churn risk, cohort retention rates, and intervention triggers. Combines behavioral data with predictive signals to help teams act before customers leave.
impact: Enabled proactive retention actions by surfacing at-risk customers weeks before churn.

title: Customer Journey Analytics
description: Full-funnel customer journey visualization tracking touchpoints from acquisition through conversion and loyalty. Maps behavioral patterns across channels to reveal drop-off points and optimization opportunities.
impact: Revealed key drop-off stages in the customer funnel, driving targeted UX and marketing improvements.

title: Regional Sales Performance Tracker
description: Multi-region sales performance dashboard with drill-down capabilities. Maps sales by region, tracks KPIs against targets, and generates automated weekly performance reports.
impact: Enabled regional managers to identify underperformance 2 weeks earlier on average.

title: Loyalty Program Analytics Platform
description: End-to-end loyalty program dashboard tracking member enrollment, point redemption, tier progression, and churn prediction. Integrates with POS data for real-time updates.
impact: Increased loyalty program engagement by 28% through data-driven reward optimization.

title: Gender-Based Product Performance Analysis
description: Comprehensive analysis of product performance segmented by customer gender, purchase frequency, and basket size. Produces automated reports with actionable merchandising recommendations.
impact: Informed product category decisions that increased average basket value by 18%.

title: New Products Dashboard
description: Real-time analytics dashboard tracking new product launches, performance metrics, and market adoption. Monitors sales velocity, customer reception, and ROI for new SKUs across categories.
impact: Accelerated new product go/no-go decisions with live performance tracking and early adoption signals.
